unresolved: P_corr_north_w declared on its measured north face line y957 (faces 957/969) so it closes at the strip ring corner; the corridor polygon therefore includes that 12px wall band on its north side.

Interior partition faces measured from single line pairs; exact thicknesses below drawing line width are uncertain.

data.question: This is an architectural floor plan (black background, grey wall lines, cyan door/window symbols, magenta furniture). Task: locate every DOOR symbol, identified by a quarter-circle swing arc plus a straight door leaf line. For each door, report: (1) the pixel coordinates of its two jambs (the ends of the opening in the wall), (2) which wall it is in (describe the wall's orientation and nearby features). Include exterior doors in outer walls. Be exhaustive and systematic: scan the plan row by row from top to bottom. Do NOT count windows (straight parallel cyan lines without arcs) or furniture.
